scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "uv run python backend/manage.py runserver 8808" "bun run --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.test: uv run python backend/manage.py test planner && bun run --cwd frontend test -- --run
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check backend && bun run --cwd frontend lint
scripts.deploy: bun run build && uv run pywrangler deploy
